sanskrit:
तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान् ।
क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु ॥ १६-१९॥
iast:
tānahaṃ dviṣataḥ krūrānsaṃsāreṣu narādhamān
kṣipāmyajasramaśubhān  āsurīṣveva yoniṣu 16-19
translation: These cruel haters, worst among men in the world, I hurl these evil-doers for ever into the wombs of the demons only.
